How to Beat Malenia: Complete Strategy & No-Damage Tips

2026-07-27•12 min read

Malenia, Blade of Miquella stands as Elden Ring's most notorious boss, a challenge that has claimed countless Tarnished lives since the game's release. Located at the base of the Haligtree after conquering one of the most difficult legacy dungeons in the game, Malenia represents the ultimate test of skill, patience, and build optimization. This comprehensive guide will walk you through everything you need to know to defeat her, from exploiting her weaknesses to executing perfect dodges during her infamous Waterfowl Dance.

Location and Preparation

Reaching Malenia requires completing the Haligtree dungeon, which begins at the Consecrated Snowfield. You'll need to solve the complex puzzle involving two halves of the Haligtree Secret Medallion, accessible through a specific sequence of events starting in the Village of the Albinaurics. The dungeon itself is filled with challenging enemies, including Kindred of Rot and Cleanrot Knights, so ensure you're adequately prepared before attempting this gauntlet.

Before facing Malenia, stock up on these essentials: +25 Boluses (particularly Golden Vow or Exalted Flesh), maximum healing flasks, and resistance-boosting items. Your recommended level is 150+, with Vigor at 40-50 to survive her devastating attacks. If you're attempting a no-damage run, focus on memorizing her move patterns and perfecting your dodge timing.

Understanding Malenia's Weaknesses

Malenia has three critical vulnerabilities that can significantly ease your fight:

  • Fire Damage: Malenia takes 20% increased damage from fire attacks. Fire-based weapons, incantations like "Flame, Grant Me Strength" and "Giantsflame Take Thee," or weapons infused with Flame Art can exploit this weakness effectively.
  • Frost Buildup: While frost doesn't deal massive direct damage, it slows her attack speed and prevents her from healing on hit during the frost duration. Weapons with frost infusion or the Hoarfrost Stomp Ash of War are particularly valuable.
  • Bleed Buildup: Malenia is highly susceptible to hemorrhage. Weapons like the Bloodhound's Fang, Rivers of Blood, or any weapon with the Blood Affinity can trigger bleed procs that deal significant percentage-based damage.

Phase 1 Strategy

Malenia's first phase focuses on rapid, aggressive melee combos. Her most dangerous moves include:

The Quick Slash Combo

Malenia performs a fast horizontal slash followed by an upward strike. Dodge the first hit to your right, then roll through the second attack to position yourself behind her for counterattacks. Timing is crucial—don't panic roll too early or you'll get caught by the follow-up.

The Spinning Slash

She leaps into the air and performs a spinning attack. Run directly away from her during the jump, then dodge roll as she lands. This creates an opening for 2-3 hits before she recovers.

Thrust Attacks

Malenia's thrust moves are telegraphed by her pulling her blade back. Dodge to the side (left is generally safer) rather than backward, as her thrust has incredible range and can catch you even at medium distance.

During Phase 1, maintain medium distance to bait her attacks while staying close enough to punish recovery frames. Never get greedy with attacks—2-3 hits maximum before repositioning. Her health pool is substantial, so patience is essential.

Phase 2: The Scarlet Rot Goddess

When Malenia reaches 50% health, she transforms into the Goddess of Rot, gaining new devastating attacks and the ability to inflict Scarlet Rot. This phase is where most players meet their demise, but with proper preparation, it's manageable.

Waterfowl Dance - The Fight Ender

Malenia's most infamous attack involves a rapid flurry of slashes across the arena. Here's the exact timing for no-damage Waterfowl Dance dodges:

  • First jump: Dodge toward her left side (your right) as she leaps into the air
  • First flurry: Immediately prepare to dodge again—she'll attack in a circular pattern
  • Second position: Roll through her attacks to get behind her
  • Final flurry: Time your dodge to the rhythm of her slashes, rolling through the final attack

The key is not to panic roll. Watch her blade carefully and dodge at the last possible moment. If you have the "Bloodhound's Step" Ash of War, you can use it to create distance during the first jump, giving you more time to react.

Scarlet Rot Attacks

In Phase 2, Malenia gains attacks that inflict Scarlet Rot, which drains your health over time. Bring Preserving Boluses (10-15 should suffice) to cure the buildup immediately. Alternatively, the "Flame, Cleanse Me" incantation can remove rot, though it requires 18 Faith and leaves you vulnerable during casting.

Recommended Builds and Equipment

Melee Build (Strength/Dexterity)

Use a weapon with Blood or Flame Art affinity. The Greatsword or Claymore with Blood Affinity offers excellent damage and bleed buildup. Pair with the "Bloodflame Blade" incantation for additional fire damage.

Essential Talismans:

  • Radagon's Soreseal: Boosts Strength and Dexterity by 5 each (at the cost of increased damage taken)
  • Rotten Winged Sword Insignia: Increases attack power with successive attacks
  • Erdtree's Favor: Boosts maximum HP, stamina, and equip load
  • Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +2: Significantly reduces physical damage taken

Mage Build (Intelligence)

The Comet Azspell combined with "Terra Magicus" and "Scholar's Armament" can deal massive damage during opening windows. Use "Adula's Moonblade" for frost buildup. Equip the "Magic Scorpion Charm" to boost spell damage by 12%.

Faith Build

"Black Flame Blade" on a fast weapon like the Scimitar or Falchion deals percentage-based damage over time. Pair with "Golden Vow" for damage and defense buffs. The "Godslayer's Seal" boosts Black Flame incantations by significant amounts.

Summon Recommendations

While Malenia can be defeated solo, spirit ashes can provide valuable distractions:

  • Mimic Tear +10: Your most reliable summon, capable of tanking hits and dealing consistent damage. It copies your build and equipment.
  • Black Knife Tiche +10: Excellent for dodge-heavy playstyles, Tiche can draw aggro while you attack from behind.
  • Lhewell the Turtle King +10: Surprisingly effective tank that can absorb significant damage.

Cooperators: If using multiplayer, coordinate with your summon before engaging. Have them focus on healing or ranged attacks while you draw Malenia's aggression.

No-Damage Tips and Advanced Techniques

Achieving a no-damage victory against Malenia requires mastery of several techniques:

  • Learn her tells: Every attack has a specific animation startup. The horizontal slash starts with her right arm pulling back, while thrusts begin with her blade pointing forward.
  • Positioning is everything: Stay at her left hip (your right side) for most attacks. This positions you in her blind spot for many moves.
  • Don't overcommit: Even in Phase 1, limit yourself to 2-3 attacks before repositioning. Malenia can recover faster than you expect.
  • Use the arena: The circular arena allows you to create distance and reset the fight's tempo. Use it to your advantage.
  • Practice patience: Malenia punishes aggression heavily. Wait for openings rather than forcing attacks.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Many Tarnished fall to these common errors:

  • Greedy attacks: Trying to land 4-5 hits instead of 2-3 is the #1 cause of death
  • Panic rolling: Dodging too early leaves you vulnerable during recovery frames
  • Ignoring Phase 2 transition: Failing to prepare for Scarlet Rot can end the fight instantly
  • Poor stamina management: Always keep enough stamina for at least 2 dodge rolls
  • Standing still: Malenia's attacks cover large areas; constant movement is essential

Rewards and Aftermath

Defeating Malenia grants you the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess, which can be exchanged with Enia at the Roundtable Hold for either:

  • Hand of Malenia: A katana with incredible range and the "Waterfowl Dance" weapon skill
  • Scarlet Aeonia: An incantation that summons a massive scarlet flower, dealing heavy damage and inflicting Scarlet Rot

You'll also receive 480,000 runes, making this one of the most lucrative boss fights in the game. The achievement "Malenia, Blade of Miquella" is also unlocked, marking your victory over Elden Ring's ultimate challenge.

Conclusion

Malenia represents the pinnacle of Elden Ring's challenge, but she's far from unbeatable. By understanding her weaknesses, mastering her attack patterns, and preparing the right build, you can emerge victorious. Remember that patience and observation are your greatest weapons—learn her moves, respect her power, and strike only when the opening is clear. With practice and persistence, you'll join the ranks of those who have conquered the Blade of Miquella.
